headline: Wardens Trim Colonial Lead on Nevish Line; Expanse Still Burns
war_summary: Nevish Line, given to the Colonials at six stands to two in our last edition, has swung back toward even: the Wardens now hold three posts to four, one more lies in rubble, and fresh fighting was logged at Grief Mother, Blackcoat Way and Blinding Stones. Its day's dead, above twenty-one thousand, are the war's heaviest. The Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ground with fifty-three flag events in a day, Wightwalk and Crow's Nest the most fought-over, and its ledger now reads three stands apiece with three razed. Linn Mercy's count moved to seven Colonial against three Warden, its day's toll near seventeen thousand, with Lathair and Outwich Ranch still the storm-centres. Mooring County's tempest at The Wind Hills has slackened sharply, and Stonecradle's contest about World's End and The Reach has gone quiet. Where flags still, blood does not: Callahans Passage takes casualties at some fifty an hour a side with no flags moving, and the Dead Lands, lately cool, burn again with Warden losses steepest. It is day 751; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
